text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Friday the number of its listings would rise to 54 next week, with two more companies joining in trading on the second tier on Monday.
The newcomers are Promet SA metal parts maker based in the Transylvanian city of Beclean and the Prodplast SA plastics factory in Bucharest.
* Number of shares: 1,377,227; each share has a face value of 25,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: The State Ownership Fund (FPS) has a 70.33 percent, local investment fund Banat-Crisana has 14 percent and other investors 15.66. Managers hold the rest.
* Net profit in 1996: 1.402 billion lei; in 1995 124.04 million lei.
* Dividend per share: in 1996 315.71 lei; in 1995 27.7 lei.
* Number of shares: 685,668; each share has a face value of 25,000 lei.
* Ownership structure: The FPS holds 3.8 percent, employees 39 percent and other investors 57.2 percent.
* Net profit in 1996: 3.04 billion lei; in 1995 1.577 billion lei.
* Dividend per share in 1996: 3,881 lei; in 1995 2,029 lei.
The Bucharest stock exchange trades 46 firms on the second tier and eight companies on the first tier.
